description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named AnswerController that manages CRUD operations for 'Answer' entities linked to 'Question' entities via REST API endpoints.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: REST controller that provides endpoints to retrieve, create, update, and delete answers associated with questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of answers for a specific question identified by questionId.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Creates a new answer for a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Updates the text of an existing answer linked to a specific question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Deletes an answer associated with a question.
